official_alert.headline: One train will express southbound from Olney Station to Girard Station as a line adjustment due to earlier delays. The following train will accommodate the passengers.

official_alert.headline: Service ends at Erie Station, Shuttle Busing between Olney and Fern Rock Transit Center
official_alert.description: B3 trains will operate only between 8th-Market and Erie Stations, and bus service replaces trains between Olney and Fern Rock Transit Center for the entire service day on Saturday, October 10 due to construction. Passengers may transfer to any B1 train at Erie Station to make their connection.

versions.short_description: B3 trains will operate only between 8th-Market and Erie Stations, and bus service replaces trains between Olney and Fern Rock Transit Center for the entire service day on Saturday, October 10 and Sunday, October 11 due to construction. Passengers may transfer to any B1 train at Erie Station to make their connection.
